text:
# Three Facts About Honey

Honey is one of the oldest foods people still eat.

## It never spoils

Archaeologists have found pots of honey more than 3,000 years old that were still safe to eat.

## Bees work hard

To make one jar of honey, bees visit about two million flowers.
